110	    // MARK: - The read
111	
112	    /// The document's snapshot, scope and transcript cache, read once.
113	    ///
114	    /// Named clips are the scope (`.selected`); with none named, the
115	    /// selection when `Transcriber.jobs` accepts any of it, else every clip.
116	    /// The EDITED project, as `SilenceDetector.read` takes it: with a nest
117	    /// open the ranges are the nest's, in the nest's own time.
118	    static func read(from document: ProjectDocument, clips named: [UInt32]?) -> Input {
119	        let snapshot = document.editedProject.snapshot
120	        let urls = document.mediaURLs()
121	        let maps = document.editedProject.sourceMap
122	        let scope: Scope
123	        let chosen: [ClipSnapshot]
124	        if let named {
125	            let ids = Set(named)
126	            chosen = snapshot.clips.filter { ids.contains($0.id) }
127	            scope = .selected
128	        } else {
129	            let selected = snapshot.clips.filter { document.selection.contains($0.id) }
130	            if !Transcriber.jobs(for: selected, in: snapshot, urls: urls, maps: maps).jobs.isEmpty {
131	                chosen = selected
132	                scope = .selected
133	            } else {
134	                chosen = snapshot.clips
135	                scope = .all
136	            }
137	        }
138	        let (kept, locked) = onUnlockedTracks(chosen, in: snapshot)
139	        let (jobs, problems) = Transcriber.jobs(for: kept, in: snapshot, urls: urls, maps: maps)
140	        let cacheDirectory = document.cacheDirectory
141	
142	        var clips: [ClipWords] = []
143	        var needs: Set<UInt32> = []
144	        var scopeFiles: [UInt32: MediaTranscript.File?] = [:]
145	        for job in jobs {
146	            if scopeFiles[job.media] == nil {
147	                scopeFiles[job.media] = .some(
148	                    cacheDirectory.flatMap { cache in
149	                        snapshot.media(job.media).flatMap {
150	                            fillersFile(for: $0, url: job.source, in: cache)
151	                        }
152	                    })
153	            }
154	            if let file = scopeFiles[job.media] ?? nil {
155	                clips.append(ClipWords(job: job, file: file))
156	            } else {
157	                needs.insert(job.media)
158	            }
159	        }
160	
161	        var neighbours: [ClipWords] = []
162	        if let cacheDirectory {
163	            let unlocked = onUnlockedTracks(snapshot.clips, in: snapshot).kept
164	            var files: [UInt32: MediaTranscript.File?] = [:]
165	            let found = Transcriber.jobs(for: unlocked, in: snapshot, urls: urls, maps: maps)
166	            for job in found.jobs {
167	                if files[job.media] == nil {
168	                    files[job.media] = .some(
169	                        snapshot.media(job.media).flatMap {
170	                            transcriptFile(
171	                                for: $0, url: job.source, in: cacheDirectory, use: .captions)
172	                        })
173	                }
174	                if let file = files[job.media] ?? nil {
175	                    neighbours.append(ClipWords(job: job, file: file))
176	                }
177	            }
178	        }
179	        return Input(
180	            fps: snapshot.canvas.fps, scope: scope, clips: clips, needsTranscript: needs.sorted(),
181	            skipped: named == nil ? [] : problems, locked: locked, neighbours: neighbours,
182	            nests: SilenceDetector.nestExtents(in: snapshot),
183	            walls: SilenceDetector.overlapWalls(snapshot))
184	    }

186	    /// The scope's door: a media's transcript only when its marker serves
187	    /// filler removal (TR-7, TR-2).
188	    static func fillersFile(
189	        for media: MediaSnapshot, url: URL, in cacheDir: URL
190	    ) -> MediaTranscript.File? {
191	        transcriptFile(for: media, url: url, in: cacheDir, use: .fillers)

194	    /// A media's cached transcript when the file as it is NOW stamps the
195	    /// marker's source, the file reads, and the marker serves `use` for the
196	    /// request the file records; else nil.
197	    static func transcriptFile(
198	        for media: MediaSnapshot, url: URL, in cacheDir: URL, use: TranscriptUse
199	    ) -> MediaTranscript.File? {
200	        guard let stamp = MediaImporter.CacheStamp.stamp(for: media, url: url),
201	            let file = MediaTranscript.read(for: media.id, in: cacheDir),
202	            let marker = MediaTranscript.readStamp(for: media.id, in: cacheDir),
203	            marker.serves(TranscriptStamp(source: stamp, options: file.header.requested), for: use)
204	        else { return nil }
205	        return file
206	    }

208	    /// The clips not on a locked track, and the ids of those that are,
209	    /// sorted. A track the snapshot cannot find counts as unlocked, as the
210	    /// nest walls read it.
211	    static func onUnlockedTracks(
212	        _ clips: [ClipSnapshot], in snapshot: ProjectSnapshot
213	    ) -> (kept: [ClipSnapshot], locked: [UInt32]) {
214	        var kept: [ClipSnapshot] = []
215	        var locked: [UInt32] = []
216	        for clip in clips {
217	            if snapshot.track(clip.track)?.locked == true {
218	                locked.append(clip.id)
219	            } else {
220	                kept.append(clip)
221	            }
222	        }
223	        return (kept, locked.sorted())
224	    }

226	    // MARK: - The arithmetic
227	
228	    /// One word of a clip's window, in source ticks.
229	    private struct Timed {
230	        let text: String
231	        let start: Ticks
232	        let end: Ticks
233	        let filler: Bool
234	    }
235	
236	    /// The clip's words in source ticks: those whose start is in its window
237	    /// (R6-10), sorted by start then end.
238	    private static func timed(_ file: MediaTranscript.File, in job: Transcriber.Job) -> [Timed] {
239	        let windowEnd = job.sourceIn + job.sourceLength
240	        var out: [Timed] = []
241	        for word in file.words {
242	            let start = MediaTranscript.sourceTicks(milliseconds: word.start)
243	            guard start >= job.sourceIn, start < windowEnd else { continue }
244	            out.append(
245	                Timed(
246	                    text: word.text, start: start,
247	                    end: MediaTranscript.sourceTicks(milliseconds: max(word.start, word.end)),
248	                    filler: FillerWords.isFiller(word.text)))
249	        }
250	        return out.sorted { ($0.start, $0.end) < ($1.start, $1.end) }
251	    }
252	
253	    /// Every maximal run of consecutive fillers in the clip's word order,
254	    /// with the non-filler words that bound it (TR-9).
255	    static func runs(of file: MediaTranscript.File, in job: Transcriber.Job) -> [Run] {
256	        let words = timed(file, in: job)
257	        let windowEnd = job.sourceIn + job.sourceLength
258	        // The latest non-filler end before each index, and the earliest
259	        // non-filler start after it.
260	        var before = [Ticks](repeating: job.sourceIn, count: words.count + 1)
261	        for (index, word) in words.enumerated() {
262	            before[index + 1] = word.filler ? before[index] : max(before[index], word.end)
263	        }
264	        var after = [Ticks](repeating: windowEnd, count: words.count + 1)
265	        for index in stride(from: words.count - 1, through: 0, by: -1) {
266	            let word = words[index]
267	            after[index] = word.filler ? after[index + 1] : min(after[index + 1], word.start)
268	        }
269	        var runs: [Run] = []
270	        var open: [Int] = []
271	        func close() {
272	            guard let first = open.first, let last = open.last else { return }
273	            runs.append(
274	                Run(
275	                    words: open.map { words[$0].text },
276	                    source: SilenceDetector.Span(
277	                        start: words[first].start, end: open.map { words[$0].end }.max() ?? 0),
278	                    previousEnd: before[first], nextStart: after[last + 1]))
279	            open = []
280	        }
281	        for (index, word) in words.enumerated() {
282	            guard word.filler else {
283	                close()
284	                continue
285	            }
286	            open.append(index)
287	        }
288	        close()
289	        return runs
290	    }

292	    private static func down(_ t: Ticks, _ grid: Ticks) -> Ticks {
293	        let q = t / grid
294	        return (t % grid != 0 && t < 0 ? q - 1 : q) * grid
295	    }
296	
297	    private static func up(_ t: Ticks, _ grid: Ticks) -> Ticks {
298	        let q = t / grid
299	        return (t % grid != 0 && t > 0 ? q + 1 : q) * grid
300	    }
301	
302	    /// A run's source span widened outward to the grid, bounded by its
303	    /// neighbours' grid points inward; nil when nothing is left.
304	    static func gridded(_ run: Run, grid: Ticks) -> SilenceDetector.Span? {
305	        guard grid > 0 else { return nil }
306	        let start = max(down(run.source.start, grid), up(run.previousEnd, grid))
307	        let end = min(up(run.source.end, grid), down(run.nextStart, grid))
308	        guard end > start else { return nil }
309	        return SilenceDetector.Span(start: start, end: end)
310	    }
311	
312	    /// A source span in project time, its start snapped up and its end down
313	    /// to the frame grid; nil when nothing is left.
314	    static func placed(
315	        _ source: SilenceDetector.Span, in job: Transcriber.Job, fps: Fps
316	    ) -> SilenceDetector.Span? {
317	        let span = SilenceDetector.Span(
318	            start: SilenceDetector.snapUpToFrame(
319	                MediaTranscript.project(source.start, in: job), fps: fps),
320	            end: SilenceDetector.snapDownToFrame(
321	                MediaTranscript.project(source.end, in: job), fps: fps))
322	        guard span.end > span.start else { return nil }
323	        return span
324	    }

326	    // MARK: - Detection
327	
328	    /// The candidates, what was dropped and why, and the merged ranges.
329	    static func detect(_ input: Input) -> Outcome {
330	        // Every neighbour's non-filler words in project time, read once.
331	        let guarded: [(clip: UInt32, words: [CaptionCues.Word])] = input.neighbours.map {
332	            ($0.job.clip,
333	             MediaTranscript.words(for: $0.job, in: $0.file).filter {
334	                 !FillerWords.isFiller($0.text)
335	             })
336	        }
337	        var candidates: [Candidate] = []
338	        var dropped: [Dropped] = []
339	        for clip in input.clips {
340	            let id = clip.job.clip
341	            for run in runs(of: clip.file, in: clip.job) {
342	                guard let source = gridded(run, grid: grid),
343	                    let span = placed(source, in: clip.job, fps: input.fps)
344	                else {
345	                    dropped.append(Dropped(clip: id, words: run.words, reason: .tooShort))
346	                    continue
347	                }
348	                if let reason = conflict(span, clip: id, guarded: guarded, input: input) {
349	                    dropped.append(Dropped(clip: id, words: run.words, reason: reason))
350	                    continue
351	                }
352	                candidates.append(Candidate(clip: id, words: run.words, source: source, span: span))
353	            }
354	        }
355	        return Outcome(
356	            spans: SilenceDetector.merged(candidates.map(\.span)), candidates: candidates,
357	            dropped: dropped, scope: input.scope,
358	            clips: Set(input.clips.map { $0.job.clip }).sorted(),
359	            needsTranscript: input.needsTranscript, skipped: input.skipped, locked: input.locked)
360	    }
361	
362	    /// Why a span may not be cut, in TR-9's order: another clip's word, a
363	    /// nest clip, a transition wall; nil when it may.
364	    private static func conflict(
365	        _ span: SilenceDetector.Span, clip: UInt32,
366	        guarded: [(clip: UInt32, words: [CaptionCues.Word])], input: Input
367	    ) -> DropReason? {
368	        for neighbour in guarded where neighbour.clip != clip {
369	            if let word = neighbour.words.first(where: {
370	                SilenceDetector.overlap(span, SilenceDetector.Span(start: $0.start, end: $0.end)) > 0
371	            }) {
372	                return .overlapsWord(clip: neighbour.clip, text: word.text)
373	            }
374	        }
375	        if let nest = input.nests.first(where: { SilenceDetector.overlap(span, $0.span) > 0 }) {
376	            return .nest(clip: nest.clip)
377	        }
378	        if input.walls.contains(where: { SilenceDetector.overlap(span, $0) > 0 }) {
379	            return .transition
380	        }
381	        return nil
382	    }
383	}

334	        let selection: Set<UInt32>
335	        let cache: URL?
336	        let stamp: Date?

141	    /// One media's paid upload, on `CloudTranscriber.run`'s own queue, with
142	    /// the request `FillerTranscription` builds; the completion arrives on
143	    /// main and goes to `runEnded`.
144	    func transcribe(media: UInt32) {
145	        guard let document = document, let cache = cacheDirectory,
146	            let credential = AssemblyAIConfiguration.credential(
147	                store: store, environment: environment)
148	        else {
149	            NSSound.beep()
150	            return
151	        }
152	        let client: AssemblyAIClient
153	        do {
154	            client = AssemblyAIClient(
155	                base: try AssemblyAIConfiguration.baseURL(defaults: defaults),
156	                credential: credential)
157	        } catch {
158	            lastError = error.localizedDescription
159	            refresh()
160	            return
161	        }
162	        let snapshot = document.editedProject.snapshot
163	        let jobs = FillerTranscription.jobs(
164	            for: media, in: snapshot, urls: document.mediaURLs(),
165	            maps: document.editedProject.sourceMap)
166	        guard !jobs.isEmpty else {
167	            NSSound.beep()
168	            return
169	        }
170	        var records: [UInt32: MediaSnapshot] = [:]
171	        for entry in snapshot.media { records[entry.id] = entry }
172	        let run = CloudTranscriber(client: client, cacheDirectory: cache, media: records)
173	        let cancel = Transcriber.CancelToken()
174	        cloud = run
175	        token = cancel
176	        runStarted(media: media)
177	        run.run(
178	            jobs: jobs,
179	            options: FillerTranscription.options(
180	                for: MediaTranscript.readStamp(for: media, in: cache)),
181	            refresh: FillerTranscription.refresh,
182	            frame: max(snapshot.canvas.fps.frameDuration, 1),
183	            pages: CaptionPages.Request(
184	                style: .subtitles,
185	                canvas: CGSize(width: snapshot.canvas.width, height: snapshot.canvas.height)),
186	            cancel: cancel,
187	            progress: { [weak self] fraction, detail in
188	                DispatchQueue.main.async { self?.progressed(media, fraction, detail) }
189	            },
190	            completion: { [weak self] outcome in
191	                guard let self = self, !self.tornDown else { return }
192	                if case .failure(let error) = outcome {
193	                    self.runEnded(error: error)
194	                } else {
195	                    self.runEnded(error: nil)
196	                }
197	            })
198	    }

200	    /// The running row's estimate line, while it runs.
201	    private func progressed(_ media: UInt32, _ fraction: Double, _ detail: String) {
202	        guard media == runningMedia, let row = mediaRows.first(where: { $0.media == media })
203	        else { return }
204	        let percent = "\(Int((min(max(fraction, 0), 1) * 100).rounded())) %"
205	        row.estimate.stringValue = (detail.isEmpty ? "Transcribing" : detail) + " · " + percent
206	    }
207	}

3	/// Remove Filler Words' re-transcribe (road map "cut-by-transcript" CT-3, spec
4	/// §11 TR-2, TR-7, TR-10): the request, the jobs and the estimate one press
5	/// of the sheet's Transcribe button sends for one media, shared by the sheet
6	/// (`FillerSheetController+Transcribe.swift`) and its mirror,
7	/// `transcribe_for_fillers` (`AgentServer+Fillers.swift`), so the two cannot
8	/// send different requests or quote different prices.
9	///
10	/// It holds no document. The jobs come from a snapshot and its media URLs,
11	/// and the estimate from a cache directory, all passed by value — which is
12	/// what lets the tool read them in one main-thread hop and run off main.
13	///
14	/// **TR-10's request.** The media's PREVIOUS request is kept — the marker's
15	/// language, speaker labels and vocabulary — so the filler transcript is the
16	/// same transcript as before with the fillers in it; the shipped models,
17	/// `disfluencies: true` and `refresh: true` are added. With no marker it is
18	/// detection, no speakers and no vocabulary. `refresh` is what makes a media
19	/// whose caption transcript is current upload again: `CloudEstimate.fate`
20	/// and `CloudTranscriber.transcribe` both judge currency for `.captions`,
21	/// which ignores `disfluencies` (TR-2).
22	enum FillerTranscription {
23	
24	    /// Always on: a media in the sheet's list has a transcript that serves
25	    /// captions or none, and either way it must be fetched again.
26	    static let refresh = true
27	
28	    /// The marker's request with fillers asked for, or detection with none.
29	    static func options(for marker: TranscriptStamp?) -> TranscriptOptions {
30	        TranscriptOptions(
31	            speechModels: TranscriptOptions.shippedModels,
32	            languageCode: marker?.languageCode,
33	            speakerLabels: marker?.speakerLabels ?? false,
34	            keytermsPrompt: marker?.keytermsPrompt ?? [],
35	            disfluencies: true)
36	    }
37	
38	    /// `Transcriber.jobs` over the snapshot's clips that play `media`; the
39	    /// clips it refuses (a reversed one, one whose audio is off, a missing
40	    /// file) are left out, as a caption run leaves them. `maps` are the
41	    /// source maps of the snapshot's handle, so a ramped clip's job follows
42	    /// its map (spec §11 SR-20 (d)).
43	    static func jobs(
44	        for media: UInt32, in snapshot: ProjectSnapshot, urls: [UInt32: URL], maps: SourceMaps
45	    ) -> [Transcriber.Job] {
46	        let clips = snapshot.clips.filter { clip in
47	            guard case .media(let id, _, _) = clip.source else { return false }
48	            return id == media
49	        }
50	        return Transcriber.jobs(for: clips, in: snapshot, urls: urls, maps: maps).jobs
51	    }
52	
53	    /// What one press would upload and cost, by `CloudEstimate`'s own rules
54	    /// over the same request the run sends; nil when there is nothing to run.
55	    static func estimate(
56	        jobs: [Transcriber.Job], media: [UInt32: MediaSnapshot], cacheDirectory: URL
57	    ) -> CloudEstimate? {
58	        guard !jobs.isEmpty else { return nil }
59	        let facts = CloudEstimate.facts(jobs: jobs, media: media, cacheDirectory: cacheDirectory)
60	        return CloudEstimate(
61	            facts: facts, options: options(for: facts.first?.marker), refresh: refresh)
62	    }
63	}

3	/// The one filler vocabulary (spec §11 TR-8) and the rule that matches a word
4	/// against it. Every caption producer's input passes through
5	/// `MediaTranscript.captionWords`, so a caption made from a transcript that
6	/// asked for fillers (TR-1) is the caption the same words make without them.
7	///
8	/// The cache keeps every served word verbatim (R6-3): this filters decoded
9	/// words only, and `wordsJSON` and `File.encoded()` never see it.
10	enum FillerWords {
11	
12	    /// TR-8's list: the tokens AssemblyAI itself names as fillers for the
13	    /// models the app requests. "uh huh" is matched by its two halves, and
14	    /// `uh-huh` as one token. Another source's fillers (TR-7) are added by
15	    /// that source's own entry.
16	    static let assemblyAI: Set<String> = [
17	        "um", "uh", "hmm", "mhm", "uh-huh", "ah", "huh", "hm", "m", "er", "erm",
18	    ]
19	
20	    /// Lowercased, then leading and trailing punctuation and whitespace
21	    /// trimmed: `"Um,"` is `"um"`, and an inner hyphen stays.
22	    static func normalized(_ text: String) -> String {
23	        text.lowercased().trimmingCharacters(in: trimmed)
24	    }
25	
26	    /// The set `normalized` trims, made once: building the union on every
27	    /// call was nine tenths of placing a 27,000-word timeline transcript
28	    /// (185 of 200 ms, measured for TX2a's T6).
29	    private static let trimmed = CharacterSet.punctuationCharacters.union(.whitespacesAndNewlines)
30	
31	    /// Whether a word is a filler: its normalised text is in the list.
32	    static func isFiller(_ text: String) -> Bool {
33	        assemblyAI.contains(normalized(text))
34	    }
35	}
36	
37	extension MediaTranscript {
38	
39	    /// `words(for:in:)` with every `FillerWords.isFiller` word removed; the
40	    /// order and every other word untouched. What a caption is made from.
41	    static func captionWords(for job: Transcriber.Job, in file: File) -> [CaptionCues.Word] {
42	        words(for: job, in: file).filter { !FillerWords.isFiller($0.text) }
43	    }
44	}

4	/// Filler Words… (road map "cut-by-transcript" CT-2, CT-3) and the agent's

6	/// mirror of that sheet's Transcribe button (TR-10).

9	/// registers no undo step, as `detect_silence` does
10	/// (`AgentServer+Silence.swift`, whose posture this follows). The words are
11	/// a Swift cache (`cache/transcripts/`), so an agent that could only call
12	/// `ripple_delete_ranges` would have nothing to cut by; this answers the
13	/// ranges and `ripple_delete_ranges` makes the one undo step.
14	///
15	/// It stays on the MAIN thread, out of `AgentServer.offMainTools`, for
16	/// `detect_silence`'s reason: reading a few cached transcripts and one pass
17	/// of arithmetic waits on nothing and has no completion to deliver. It never
18	/// makes a network call: only a cached AssemblyAI transcript that asked for
19	/// filler words is read (TR-7). `transcribe_for_fillers` is the other
20	/// posture: a paid upload, off main (`AgentServer.offMainTools`), always
21	/// withheld from the assistant (AI-7 as TR-10 amends it).
22	extension AgentServer {
23	
24	    /// `detect_fillers` — the read half of Clip ▸ Remove Filler Words…, and
25	    /// the agent's path. Nothing is edited: feed `ranges` to
26	    /// `ripple_delete_ranges` to make the cut.
27	    func detectFillers(_ a: [String: Any]) throws -> String {
28	        let document = try target(a)
29	        let clips = try optionalClipsArg(a, "clips", document)
30	        let input = FillerDetector.read(from: document, clips: clips)
31	        let outcome = FillerDetector.detect(input)
32	
33	        var result: [String: Any] = [
34	            "ok": true,
35	            "ranges": outcome.spans.map { [$0.start, $0.end] },
36	            "count": outcome.spans.count,
37	            "removes": outcome.removed,
38	            "scope": outcome.scope.rawValue,
39	            "clips": outcome.clips.map { Int($0) },
40	            "fillers": outcome.candidates.map { candidate -> [String: Any] in
41	                [
42	                    "clip": Int(candidate.clip), "words": candidate.words,
43	                    "range": [candidate.span.start, candidate.span.end],
44	                ]
45	            },
46	            "dropped": outcome.dropped.map { drop -> [String: Any] in
47	                ["clip": Int(drop.clip), "words": drop.words, "reason": Self.sentence(drop.reason)]
48	            },
49	            "needs_transcript": outcome.needsTranscript.map { Int($0) },
50	            "locked": outcome.locked.map { Int($0) },
51	        ]
52	        if clips != nil, !outcome.skipped.isEmpty {
53	            result["skipped"] = outcome.skipped.map { $0.description }
54	        }
55	        var notes: [String] = []
56	        if outcome.clips.isEmpty, outcome.needsTranscript.isEmpty, outcome.locked.isEmpty {
57	            notes.append("Nothing in scope plays speech from a media file, so nothing was read.")
58	        }
59	        if !outcome.needsTranscript.isEmpty {
60	            notes.append(
61	                "Media \(Self.fillerList(outcome.needsTranscript)) has no transcript made with "
62	                    + "filler words, so its fillers cannot be found: filler removal needs an "
63	                    + "AssemblyAI transcript (spec §11 TR-7). transcribe_for_fillers makes "
64	                    + "one for a media, keeping its earlier request (a paid upload).")
65	        }
66	        if !outcome.locked.isEmpty {
67	            notes.append(
68	                "Clip \(Self.fillerList(outcome.locked)) is on a locked track, which "
69	                    + "ripple_delete_ranges neither cuts nor moves, so its fillers were not read.")
70	        }
71	        if !notes.isEmpty { result["note"] = notes.joined(separator: " ") }
72	        result["project"] = summary(document)
73	        return try jsonResult(result)
74	    }

76	    /// `transcribe_for_fillers` — the Transcribe button of Clip ▸ Remove
77	    /// Filler Words…' rows (`FillerSheetController+Transcribe.swift`): one
78	    /// media re-transcribed with AssemblyAI, with its previous request plus
79	    /// filler words (`FillerTranscription`, TR-10). Only the media's
80	    /// transcript cache is written: no caption is placed, no undo step made.
81	    ///
82	    /// Refused in this order, every step above the network: the media id,
83	    /// a document with nowhere to keep the cache, a media no clip plays from
84	    /// its file, then the credential; a media that already has a filler
85	    /// transcript answers with no request, between the last two.
86	    func transcribeForFillers(_ a: [String: Any]) throws -> String {
87	        guard !Thread.isMainThread else {
88	            throw ToolError(
89	                message: "transcribe_for_fillers must run on the server thread — its name is "
90	                    + "missing from AgentServer.offMainTools.")
91	        }
92	        struct Context {
93	            let document: ProjectDocument
94	            let media: UInt32
95	            let cache: URL
96	            let jobs: [Transcriber.Job]
97	            let records: [UInt32: MediaSnapshot]
98	            let ready: Bool
99	            let frame: Ticks
100	            let canvas: CGSize
101	        }
102	        let context = try onMain { () -> Context in
103	            let document = try self.target(a)
104	            let media = try self.mediaArg(a, "media", document)
105	            guard let cache = document.cacheDirectory else {
106	                throw ToolError(
107	                    message: "This document has nowhere to keep its transcript cache, so it "
108	                        + "cannot be transcribed with AssemblyAI. Save it first.")
109	            }
110	            let snapshot = document.editedProject.snapshot
111	            let jobs = FillerTranscription.jobs(
112	                for: media.id, in: snapshot, urls: document.mediaURLs(),
113	                maps: document.editedProject.sourceMap)
114	            guard let first = jobs.first else {
115	                throw ToolError(
116	                    message: "No clip in this timeline plays media \(media.id) from its file, so "

4	/// Silero VAD v6.2.1 through Core ML: the streaming 32 ms wrapper road map
5	/// 4's S0 spike proved and S1 ships. No AppKit, no `async` — the model
6	/// predicts synchronously, which is what lets `SilenceDetector.detect`
7	/// (never off main) and `MediaImporter+Speech.writeSpeech` (which never
8	/// `await`s) share one class.
9	///
10	/// `tools/proof/silence_spike/silero_coreml.swift`'s `Silero` made streaming:
11	/// the spike's `run` fed a whole signal and returned; `feed` holds the
12	/// remainder across calls, so a reader handing it one `CMSampleBuffer` at a
13	/// time never loses the tail of a chunk that straddled two buffers.
14	///
15	/// One instance holds one utterance's state — `h`, `c`, the 64-sample
16	/// context and the held remainder — so two media analysed concurrently
17	/// (`generateCaches`'s per-media passes run in call order, but two DIFFERENT
18	/// media can overlap) each need their own `bundled()`.
19	final class SileroVAD {
20	    static let modelName = "silero-vad-6.2.1-coreml-fp16-32ms"
21	
22	    static let sampleRate = 16_000
23	    static let chunkSamples = 512
24	    static let contextSamples = 64
25	    static let stateSize = 128
26	
27	    static let audioInput = "audio"
28	    static let stateH = "h"
29	    static let stateC = "c"
30	    static let probabilityOutput = "probability"
31	    static let stateHOut = "h_out"
32	    static let stateCOut = "c_out"
33	
34	    // MARK: - Availability
35	
36	    /// The bundled model's compiled location, or nil when this build carries
37	    /// none: `Bundle.main`'s own `Models` subdirectory first (the shipped
38	    /// app), then `bundleURL/Models/silero_vad.mlmodelc` for a binary that is
39	    /// not a proper bundle (the offscreen harness, which copies `Models`
40	    /// beside itself rather than building a bundle).
41	    static var bundledURL: URL? {
42	        if let url = Bundle.main.url(
43	            forResource: "silero_vad", withExtension: "mlmodelc", subdirectory: "Models") {
44	            return url
45	        }
46	        let sibling = Bundle.main.bundleURL
47	            .appendingPathComponent("Models", isDirectory: true)
48	            .appendingPathComponent("silero_vad.mlmodelc", isDirectory: true)
49	        return FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: sibling.path) ? sibling : nil
50	    }
51	
52	    private static let availabilityLock = NSLock()
53	    private static var unavailableReason: String?
54	
55	    /// Whether the voice model can be asked for this process. `NSLock`-guarded
56	    /// because it is written from a cache pass off main (`writeSpeech`) and
57	    /// read on main (`Input.read`) — the same shape road map 3's recorder
58	    /// gives its availability flag, and `app/CLAUDE.md`'s one sanctioned
59	    /// cross-thread lock.
60	    static var isAvailable: Bool {
61	        availabilityLock.lock()
62	        defer { availabilityLock.unlock() }
63	        return bundledURL != nil && unavailableReason == nil
64	    }
65	
66	    /// Marks the model unavailable for the rest of the process. Idempotent —
67	    /// only the FIRST reason is kept and logged, because a second failure
68	    /// after the first has nothing new to say and a log line per media would
69	    /// drown the one that mattered.
70	    static func markUnavailable(_ reason: String) {
71	        availabilityLock.lock()
72	        let first = unavailableReason == nil
73	        if first { unavailableReason = reason }
74	        availabilityLock.unlock()
75	        if first { print("Frame Job: voice model unavailable — \(reason)") }
76	    }
77	
78	    /// A fresh instance, or nil (and `markUnavailable`d) for a nil URL or a
79	    /// throwing init. FRESH per call, never shared: state is per instance,
80	    /// and passes for different media run concurrently.
81	    static func bundled() -> SileroVAD? {
82	        guard let url = bundledURL else {
83	            markUnavailable("no model in the bundle")
84	            return nil
85	        }
86	        do {
87	            return try SileroVAD(modelURL: url)
88	        } catch {
89	            markUnavailable("\(error)")
90	            return nil
91	        }
92	    }
93	
94	    // MARK: - Instance
95	
96	    private let model: MLModel
97	    private var h: MLMultiArray
98	    private var c: MLMultiArray
99	    private var context: [Float]
100	    private var remainder: [Float] = []
101	
102	    init(modelURL: URL) throws {
103	        let configuration = MLModelConfiguration()
104	        configuration.computeUnits = .cpuAndNeuralEngine
105	        model = try MLModel(contentsOf: modelURL, configuration: configuration)
106	        h = try MLMultiArray(shape: [1, 1, NSNumber(value: Self.stateSize)], dataType: .float16)
107	        c = try MLMultiArray(shape: [1, 1, NSNumber(value: Self.stateSize)], dataType: .float16)
108	        for i in 0..<Self.stateSize {
109	            h[i] = 0
110	            c[i] = 0
111	        }
112	        context = [Float](repeating: 0, count: Self.contextSamples)
113	    }
114	
115	    /// Zeroes the state and drops the held context and remainder — the start
116	    /// of a fresh utterance.
117	    func reset() {
118	        for i in 0..<Self.stateSize {
119	            h[i] = 0
120	            c[i] = 0
121	        }
122	        context = [Float](repeating: 0, count: Self.contextSamples)
123	        remainder = []
124	    }
125	
126	    /// One probability per COMPLETE 512-sample chunk `samples` completes,
127	    /// counting whatever `feed` and `flush` held from earlier calls. Any
128	    /// samples left over after the last full chunk are held for next time
129	    /// (or for `flush`).
130	    func feed(_ samples: [Float]) throws -> [Float] {
131	        var pending = remainder + samples
132	        remainder = []
133	        var probabilities: [Float] = []
134	        var offset = 0
135	        while offset + Self.chunkSamples <= pending.count {
136	            let chunk = Array(pending[offset..<(offset + Self.chunkSamples)])
137	            probabilities.append(try step(chunk))
138	            offset += Self.chunkSamples
139	        }
140	        remainder = Array(pending[offset...])
141	        pending = []
142	        return probabilities
143	    }
144	
145	    /// The held remainder, zero-padded to a full chunk and run once — or nil
146	    /// when nothing was held.
147	    func flush() throws -> Float? {
148	        guard !remainder.isEmpty else { return nil }
149	        var chunk = remainder
150	        chunk.append(contentsOf: [Float](repeating: 0, count: Self.chunkSamples - chunk.count))
151	        remainder = []
152	        return try step(chunk)
153	    }
154	
155	    /// `reset` + `feed` + `flush`: the whole signal, one call, the spike's
156	    /// `run` with the tail folded in.
157	    func probabilities(of samples: [Float]) throws -> [Float] {
158	        reset()
159	        var result = try feed(samples)
160	        if let tail = try flush() { result.append(tail) }
161	        return result
162	    }
163	
164	    /// One 512-sample chunk through the model: 64 samples of context + the
165	    /// new 512 as `[1,1,576]`, `h`/`c` fed back, the context updated to the
166	    /// chunk's last 64 samples.
167	    private func step(_ chunk: [Float]) throws -> Float {
168	        let width = Self.contextSamples + Self.chunkSamples
169	        let audio = try MLMultiArray(shape: [1, 1, NSNumber(value: width)], dataType: .float16)
170	        audio.withUnsafeMutableBytes { raw, _ in
171	            let pointer = raw.bindMemory(to: Float16.self)
172	            for i in 0..<Self.contextSamples { pointer[i] = Float16(context[i]) }
173	            for i in 0..<Self.chunkSamples { pointer[Self.contextSamples + i] = Float16(chunk[i]) }
174	        }
175	        let input = try MLDictionaryFeatureProvider(dictionary: [
176	            Self.audioInput: audio, Self.stateH: h, Self.stateC: c,
177	        ])
178	        let output = try model.prediction(from: input)
179	        guard
180	            let probabilityValue = output.featureValue(for: Self.probabilityOutput)?
181	                .multiArrayValue,
182	            let hOut = output.featureValue(for: Self.stateHOut)?.multiArrayValue,
183	            let cOut = output.featureValue(for: Self.stateCOut)?.multiArrayValue
184	        else {
185	            throw SileroError.badOutput
186	        }
187	        h = hOut
188	        c = cOut
189	        context = Array(chunk[(Self.chunkSamples - Self.contextSamples)...])
190	        return Float(truncating: probabilityValue[0])
191	    }
192	
193	    private enum SileroError: Error, CustomStringConvertible {
194	        case badOutput
195	        var description: String { "the model's output did not carry the expected features" }
196	    }
197	}

3	/// The cached Silero VAD probabilities — `cache/speech/<id>.bin` — and how to
4	/// ask them about a window, `MediaPeaks`' shape for the voice cache.
5	///
6	/// One 32-bit float per 512-sample chunk at 16 kHz (`SileroVAD.chunkSamples`
7	/// / `SileroVAD.sampleRate`), which is `chunkTicks` ticks of SOURCE time —
8	/// exactly 19,200, and written as the division rather than as the number for
9	/// the same reason `MediaPeaks.bucketTicks` is. `MediaPeaks.window` already
10	/// generalises the project-time → bucket-index arithmetic over the bucket
11	/// size, and `MediaPeaks.peak` takes the max over it on any grid, so this
12	/// file adds only the chunk grid, its loader and the question
13	/// `SilenceDetector`'s voice test asks.
14	enum MediaSpeech {
15	
16	    /// One probability's worth of source time, in ticks. Written as the
17	    /// division: `SileroVAD.sampleRate` and `SileroVAD.chunkSamples` each
18	    /// have exactly one home.
19	    static var chunkTicks: Ticks {
20	        ReelTime.perSecond * Ticks(SileroVAD.chunkSamples) / Ticks(SileroVAD.sampleRate)
21	    }
22	
23	    /// How many probabilities a file of `duration` produces — `writeSpeech`'s
24	    /// output length, so a caller can size the zero-filled buffer before any
25	    /// chunk lands.
26	    static func chunkCount(duration: Ticks) -> Int {
27	        max(1, Int((Double(duration) / Double(chunkTicks)).rounded(.up)))
28	    }
29	
30	    /// One media's cached probabilities read at most once, however many
31	    /// segments cite it — a `MediaCacheLoader` over `loadSpeech` instead of
32	    /// `loadPeaks`.
33	    static func loader(cacheDirectory: URL?) -> MediaCacheLoader<[Float]> {
34	        MediaCacheLoader(cacheDirectory: cacheDirectory) {
35	            MediaImporter.loadSpeech(for: $0, in: $1)
36	        }
37	    }
38	
39	    /// The loudest — here, most confident — probability the project span
40	    /// `[from, to)` of `segment` covers, or 0 when it falls outside the
41	    /// window the cache was built from: `MediaPeaks.peak` asked on the chunk
42	    /// grid.
43	    static func speechMax(
44	        _ p: [Float], over segment: PlanSegment, from: Ticks, to: Ticks, reversedPivot: Ticks?
45	    ) -> Float {
46	        MediaPeaks.peak(
47	            p, over: segment, from: from, to: to, reversedPivot: reversedPivot,
48	            bucketTicks: chunkTicks)
49	    }
50	}

    func rippleDeleteRanges(_ a: [String: Any]) throws -> String {

            throw ToolError(

                    + "each a time in ticks). detect_silence returns them in this shape.")

        // says only that the project is already in that state. No rule
        // refused it, so the ARGUMENT is what is named here.
        guard !ranges.isEmpty else {
            throw ToolError(message: "ranges is empty — name at least one [from, to] pair.")
        }
        return try editResult(
            document, "Ripple Delete", [.rippleDeleteRanges(ranges: ranges)])
    }

**Clip ▸ Remove Silences…** opens the Remove Silences sheet. The command is available whenever the timeline has a clip whose sound is switched on.

### What "silent" means

Silence is measured in the **mix**, as you hear it, not in the raw file:

- A clip you have turned down, faded out, ducked, muted, or silenced by soloing another track is quiet. It never keeps a cut from happening.
- A stretch where *every* clip in scope is quiet counts as silent. A music bed under a voice-over therefore keeps the pauses in the speech from being cut, unless you limit the scope to the voice clip (see **In:** below).
- A gap with nothing audible in it is left alone. Remove Silences takes dead air out of a recording; it does not close the gaps you placed between clips. **Clip ▸ Close Gap** does that.
- A muted clip is left out of the analysis entirely. A muted music bed is never read as one long silence covering the whole song.

### Judge by Voice or Level

**Judge by:** picks how a moment is tested.

| Mode | What counts as quiet | Default |
|---|---|---|
| Voice | Nobody is talking. An on-device voice-activity model listens to each media file once and keeps its answer with the project. A quiet microphone isn't mistaken for silence, and a hum isn't mistaken for speech. | Yes |
| Level | The sound in the mix is quieter than the threshold. | Used when the voice model can't be used |

In Voice mode, a clip with no voice in it at all, such as music or a tone, is judged by level instead. The sheet names each such clip, for example "Intro music at 00:00:12:00 holds no voice and is judged by level." That is why, in Voice mode, the threshold row is labelled **Level if no voice:**.

If the voice model can't be used on this Mac, the sheet opens in Level mode with Voice greyed out and says "The voice model could not be used, so quiet is judged by level." This lasts until you relaunch Frame Job.

Voice analysis runs on your Mac. Nothing is uploaded.

### The controls

| Control | What it does | Default | Range |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Judge by:** | Voice or Level, as above. | Voice | n/a |
| **Quieter than:** (Level mode) / **Level if no voice:** (Voice mode) | A slider in whole dBFS, with the value shown beside it. In Level mode, sound at or below it is quiet. In Voice mode, it judges clips that hold no voice, and a clip the mix turns down below it is quiet whatever it contains. | −40 dBFS | −80 to −10 dBFS |
| **Longer than:** | The shortest quiet stretch worth cutting, in seconds. Shorter pauses, such as the gap between two words, are kept. | 0.5 s | 0.05 to 10 s |
| **Keep at ends:** | How much of each quiet stretch to keep at each end, in seconds, so speech doesn't start or end abruptly. A stretch shorter than twice this value is not cut. | 0.1 s | 0 to 2 s |
| **In:** | **Selected clips** analyses only the selected clips. **All audible clips** analyses everything you can hear. | Selected clips when the selection includes something audible, otherwise All audible clips | n/a |

**Selected clips** is greyed out when nothing selected makes a sound. A number outside a field's range is refused: the field keeps the text and won't accept it, and **Remove** beeps, until you type a number inside the range (0.05–10 s for **Longer than:**, 0–2 s for **Keep at ends:**). The count and the shading update as you change any control.

The voice model's confidence level is not in the sheet. Agents can set it (see below).

It cuts false starts only when you ask. It can also remove fillers the same way **Remove Filler Words** does, and take out silences the way **Remove Silences** does (`detect_silence`, then one `ripple_delete_ranges`). Any cut an agent makes this way, whether silences, fillers or false starts, is one undo step labelled **Undo Ripple Delete**, not the sheet's name. The assistant can't start a paid filler transcription: press **Transcribe** in the sheet yourself. See [The assistant](assistant.md).

## Limits

- **Filler removal is cloud-only.** Without an AssemblyAI key, filler words can't be found in a file that has no filler transcript yet. A project transcribed before filler words were requested is transcribed again, and billed again, before its fillers can be cut.
- **The service can miss a filler.** A filler AssemblyAI doesn't return isn't cut. A filler it returns that isn't on the list stays in, both in the cut and in captions.
- **Protection needs a transcript.** A filler cut is kept away from speech in another clip only when that clip's file has a transcript. Speech on another unlocked track with no transcript isn't protected.
- **Up to a frame can remain.** Inward frame snapping can leave a frame of room tone, or of a filler, behind.
- **Wait for analysis.** After import, Remove Silences proposes nothing inside a file until its analysis is ready: the waveform in Level mode, the voice analysis in Voice mode (and the waveform too for a clip with no voice), except where the mix already makes it quiet.
- **Voice mode can miss a soft first word** in a quiet recording; raise **Keep at ends:** if a word is clipped.
- **Singing and voice-like instruments** may read as speech.
- **A clip that holds any voice is judged by voice for its whole length**, so a long music clip with a little speech in it isn't judged by level. Limit the scope (**In:** Selected clips) to keep music out.
- **A voice panned hard to one side** sounds quieter to the voice model.
- **In a reversed clip** a cut edge can be off by up to 32 ms.
- **Nests and transitions block cuts.** Quiet or fillers inside a nest, or in a transition's overlap, are never cut from outside the nest. Open the nest first.

See also: [Editing](editing.md) for ripple delete and Close Gap, [Audio](audio.md) for volume, fades, ducking, mute and solo, which all affect what Remove Silences hears, and [MCP](mcp.md) for the full tool reference.
